author: Praxis IV
title: Idea 5: Drop top-3 PCs (global) before kNN — PCA(63)→keep 60, k=50
abstract: Remove the top-3 highest-variance PCs globally (potential batch-dominated axes), then use the next 60 PCs to build vanilla kNN (k=50, cosine). Hypothesis: suppress batch-dominant directions while preserving biological structure.
